c.title: $4,700 / 3br - 1242ft2 - Coal Harbour View Residence | 3 Bedrooms | 2 Bathrooms | 1,242 Sq Ft (Vancouver)
c.description:
Perched high above Coal Harbour, this spacious 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence offers approximately 1,242 sq ft of interior living space and enjoys panoramic views of English Bay, the North Shore Mountains, and Vancouver's iconic waterfront skyline.

Featuring a functional and well-designed layout, the home is filled with natural light through expansive windows that showcase some of Vancouver's most sought-after views. The generous living and dining areas provide a comfortable setting for both everyday living and entertaining.

The kitchen offers a practical layout with quality appliances, ample storage, and plenty of workspace for everyday use. The primary bedroom provides excellent space and comfort, while the overall floor plan is ideal for families or professionals seeking a premier Coal Harbour location.

Residents enjoy access to an exceptional range of building amenities, including:

• 24-hour concierge
• Indoor swimming pool
• Hot tub
• Fitness centre
• Sauna and steam room
• Recently updated common areas

Situated in a well-maintained concrete high-rise in the heart of Coal Harbour, this home is steps from the waterfront seawall, Stanley Park, Robson Street shopping, downtown offices, restaurants, and cafes.

The property is currently undergoing updates and improvements, with additional details and final condition to be confirmed prior to occupancy.

PROPERTY DETAILS

Bedrooms: 3

Bathrooms: 2

Size: 1,242 sq ft

Views: English Bay, North Shore Mountains, and City Skyline

Parking: Available (please inquire)

Furnishings: Unfurnished

Building Amenities: Concierge, indoor pool, hot tub, fitness centre, sauna, steam room

RENTAL TERMS

Availability: To Be Confirmed

Utilities: Tenant responsible for applicable utilities

Pets: Subject to Owner Approval

No Smoking
